title: ExplorerCatalogScreen
responsibility: Lists components, helpers and services in searchable card grids, and shells, configs and models in tables.

inputs.name: ExplorerCatalogScreen.index
inputs.description: Prepared history index for the selected repository and its recorded revisions.

inputs.name: ExplorerCatalogScreen.head
inputs.description: Exact selected source revision supplying every displayed contract, measurement and capture.

inputs.name: ExplorerCatalogScreen.parent
inputs.description: First parent of the selected commit, or null at a branch tip or first commit.

inputs.name: ExplorerCatalogScreen.scope
inputs.description: Selected branch, commit and comparison scope shared by the explorer host.

inputs.name: ExplorerCatalogScreen.route
inputs.description: Current explorer location, including category, entity, section and tab.

inputs.name: ExplorerCatalogScreen.entities
inputs.description: Units projected from the selected revision, including entities removed by the shown commit.

inputs.name: ExplorerCatalogScreen.lens
inputs.description: Host-provided readers for entity relationships, history and selected-revision details.

inputs.name: ExplorerCatalogScreen.client
inputs.description: Revision reader used only for commits the displayed history requests.

inputs.name: ExplorerCatalogScreen.mediaBase
inputs.description: Base URL for retained recorded evidence media.

inputs.name: ExplorerCatalogScreen.onroute
inputs.description: Receives the requested explorer destination for host-controlled navigation.

outputs.name: ExplorerCatalogScreen.collection
outputs.description: Responsive grids show component screenshots, helper calls and service names with usage links. Search, filters and navigation preserve branch and commit. Shells, configs and models use tables.

errors.name: ExplorerCatalogScreen.callerError
errors.description: Caller-provided snippets, navigation and synchronous reader callbacks may throw; those errors propagate. This component defines no additional error type.
